NOT FoC 3–4h as default (foc_epic optional/aspirational only). Harvest titles: documentary_mystery (NOT What-If) via competitors_napping_historian.json. smm.live_notes: watch_live_streams (~15m) BOTH channels: soft underperform (0.20× that channel's winner median, next≥2× views, dwell/cooldown ~25m); never swap mid-stall/reconnect; top publics downloaded to output/live_vods then vod_picker playlist_<channel>; featured in smm_live_featured.json; exclude_current + single ffmpeg nudge (no dual-ingest). Farm post-public purge OK — Live uses its own library copies.

repair_watchdog.notes: HOLD-first: farm parks recoverable errors as HOLD+resumable=True (not terminal failed). Capacity watchdog */10: script_json empty-progress ≤2 then HOLD exhausted; auto_resume_hold only stamped resumable=True (runpod_transient/process_crash/edit/tts/visual_validation/unknown). GREEN start priority: resume HOLD → ready_for_stills → new approved. After repair cap → HOLD exhausted + skip to next resumable/title (never block forever). auth/budget/publish → HOLD repair_blocked. Full scan_and_repair gated by enabled (sleep do_farm usually false).

job_health_watchdog.notes: Always-on */10+*/15: dead farm resume, SFX stall (final_sfx_tmp mtime/duration), duplicate farm PIDs, compose-done upload gap, hung ffmpeg >30m. Runs before stuck scan; spawns post-pod publish without GREEN gate.

finance_agent.notes: Open-market price ticket (floor/easy-ask/stretch) for productized agency / indie ops bundle — NOT SaaS ARR. Extends CostGuardian; watchdog ticks call maybe_recompute daily. Writes output/ops/price_ticket.json + jsonl + CTO_STATUS marked section.
